text: What does your dog really understand when you talk?
In one survey, owners said their dogs responded to about eighty-nine words.
asr: In one survey, owners said their dogs responded to about 89 words.

text: Their name, sit, and come were the top three.
But a brain scan study found something cooler.
Dogs process what you say on one side of the brain,
and how you say it on the other.
Their reward area lit up most when praise words came with a happy tone.
So a flat good dog doesn't hit the same.
Say it like you mean it.
Send this to someone who talks to their dog.
